app.name: Membase
app.description: Persistent memory for ChatGPT using MCP — search, store, wiki, and cross-session handoffs

membase_search.description: Search persistent memories by semantic similarity

membase_store.description: Save important information to long-term memory

membase_profile.description: Retrieve user profile and related memories

membase_search_wiki.description: Search wiki documents for stable factual references

membase_add_wiki.description: Create a wiki document from markdown content

membase_update_wiki.description: Update title, content, or collection of an existing wiki document

positive.name: Search personal memories
positive.description: User recalls project preferences from previous sessions
positive.expectedBehavior: Returns top 3 relevant memories with dates and source tags

positive.name: Store new memory
positive.description: User saves a decision for future reference
positive.expectedBehavior: Memory stored with auto-tagging, confirmation includes memory ID

positive.name: Cross-session context recall
positive.description: User continues work from previous day with auto-recall
positive.expectedBehavior: Automatically injects top 3 relevant memories into context

positive.name: Wiki document search
positive.description: User references documentation stored in wiki
positive.expectedBehavior: Returns full document content with formatting preserved and metadata accurate

positive.name: Session handoff
positive.description: User saves ChatGPT session context for use in Cursor
positive.expectedBehavior: Creates handoff with unique token, Cursor can import and continue

negative.name: Search with no matches
negative.description: User searches for memories on unfamiliar topic
negative.expectedBehavior: Graceful empty result with clear message and no errors

negative.name: Permission denied
negative.description: User attempts wiki access without permissions
negative.expectedBehavior: Clear error message, no data corruption or permission granted

negative.name: Server timeout
negative.expectedBehavior: Times out within 5 seconds, clear error message, no hanging requests
